```{r}
if(!require("readxl")){
install.packages("readxl")
library("readxl")
}
datos<- read_excel("BaseDatosServidores.xlsx")

clases <-as.data.frame(
table(variable = factor(cut(levels(datos$EstadoServidor),
include.lowest = T,
right =F,
breaks=4))) )

TablaFrecont<- transform(clases,
porcentajes=round(prop.table(Freq)*100,2))

rownames(TablaFrecont)<-c("Clases", "Frecuencias absolutas", "Porcentajes")


if(!require("flextable")){
install.packages("flextable")
library("flextable")
}
TablaFrecont<-flextable::align(flextable(TablaFrecont),
align="center",part = "all")
TablaFrecont<-set_caption(TablaFrecont, "Cuadro 1: tabla de frecuencias del Estado del Servidor ")
TablaFrecont <- add_footer_lines(TablaFrecont, "Fuente: Equipo DevOps y Site Reliability Engineering")
TablaFrecont <- color(TablaFrecont, part ="all", color ="black")
TablaFrecont <- color(TablaFrecont, part ="header", color ="black")
TablaFrecont <- color(TablaFrecont, part ="footer", color ="black")
TablaFrecont
```

#3

```{r}
minimo <-min(datos$UsoCPU)
maximo <-max(datos$UsoCPU)

if(!require("fdth")){
install.packages("fdth")
library("fdth")
}
dist_p <- fdt(datos$UsoCPU, start = minimo, end =maximo , h = 10)
dist_p
plot(dist_p, type = "fp", las = 1, col = "blue",
main = " ",
xlab=" ", ylab=" ",
sub="Fuente: ")+abline(h = 0)
```
